synthesis.body: Astro accepts and silently ignores a malformed markdown config: `markdown: unified({ remarkPlugins: [...] })` type-checked and built green while the plugin never ran, so mermaid fences reached Expressive Code as plain code blocks and no placeholder div was ever emitted. The correct form is `markdown: { remarkPlugins: [...] }`. A transform's absence is invisible to build exit codes — after wiring any remark/rehype plugin, grep the built HTML for the transform's artifact (e.g. data-mermaid) before trusting it. Bit us for an unknown number of releases: the docs site's diagram pipeline had never actually worked.

title: Verify remark plugins fire by grepping built output — wrong registration fails silently
